connector.name: Yuque MCP by wwwwujl
connector.registryDescription: Yuque MCP server with safe read/write tools for groups, group members, repositories, docs, and TOC.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package yuque-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the wwwwujl account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: YUQUE_ALLOW_WRITE
env.description: Enable write tools when true (optional, default false)

env.name: YUQUE_WRITE_NAMESPACE_ALLOWLIST
env.description: Comma-separated namespace allowlist for repo/doc/toc writes (optional)

env.name: YUQUE_WRITE_GROUP_ALLOWLIST
env.description: Comma-separated group login allowlist for group writes (optional)

env.name: YUQUE_ALLOW_DELETE
env.description: Enable delete tools when true (optional, default false)

env.name: YUQUE_FILE_ROOT
env.description: Allowed root directory for file-based doc tools (optional, default current working directory)

env.name: YUQUE_FILE_MAX_BYTES
env.description: Maximum size for file-based doc tools (optional, default 1048576)

env.name: YUQUE_FILE_ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS
env.description: Comma-separated allowed extensions for file-based doc tools (optional, default .md,.markdown,.txt)
